 Parma, Gilardino weighs up his moves: Nicolussi Caviglia's flair to catch Roma out
 Calcio 
 In the deep-lying playmaker role, the former Juve man is favourite over the Swiss Sierro. "The Giallorossi are at a very high level, we will give it a go"
 Andrea Schianchi 
 20 november (updated at 11:57) - PARMA 
 English 
 Italiano 
 Deutsch 
 Choose Gazzetta as your preferred source on Google 
 The Tardini will erupt with passion: fifteen thousand Parma fans and three thousand from Roma, chants and banners, the spectacle off the pitch is guaranteed. A chaos that will hopefully be festive, as it always should be when sport is involved. The contest is a nail-biter: Gasp's Giallorossi are fighting to claim top spot, Gilardino's Gialloblù dream of a special day to give their people a win, to climb the table and pull themselves out of the danger zone. Having said that the Emilians will be without Romero and, probably, Bernabè and Diego Carlos as well, and having added that it should be the giant Elphege taking on the responsibility of leading the line, Gilardino is still weighing up several options. The classic pre-match doubts. One of these concerns the deep-lying playmaker role , which, in the 5-3-2 set up by the manager, is the balancing element: the player who doubles up with defensive work supporting the three centre-backs and, once in possession of the ball, is tasked with orchestrating the build-up play and dictating the tempo of the game. Battling for the starting shirt are the Swiss Vincent Sierro and Hans Nicolussi Caviglia : the latter is emerging from a long, difficult spell following surgery in the summer, and now seems to have put the required energy into his legs.
 VIDEO: Toni: "Raimondo? Mi piace, ma certe squadre italiane hanno un problema..." 
 Doubt in the middle
—   Only a few hours before the match will Gilardino decide who to hand the orchestrator's baton to, and today's scheduled final training session will therefore be crucial. With Sierro, Parma would have an already well-drilled central midfielder , who has settled quickly into the reality and the atmosphere of the Gialloblù, and who has the physicality to face very sharp opponents like the Giallorossi. He does, however, lack a bit of pace. Nicolussi Caviglia , on the other hand, guarantees more flair to the department and attacking options (set-pieces, for example) that can prove very useful. The impression is that Nicolussi will be the chosen one , provided that the very positive physical signs of recent days are confirmed in the final training sessions.
 Promise of a spectacle
—   "We certainly know the quality of Gasperini's teams," said Nicolussi Caviglia. "Right now they are at a very advanced stage of their journey, they have known each other for a long time and have spent more than a year together. Our goal will undoubtedly be to compete. It will be a good match, I think: we can't wait to take the pitch ." And in these words, one can sense the healthy anticipation that precedes every major clash, which will turn into adrenaline. On his relationship with Gilardino, the midfielder was very clear: "Every coach is different and has their own imprint. We have always trained well: we were training well before as well, we are in good shape physically . We follow directives based on the match: these change according to the opponent. But we are in good shape, that I can guarantee." And that is a certainty to rely on against Roma, because the Giallorossi run incessantly, and they do so for ninety minutes and more. A stellar performance will be needed to emerge unscathed from this duel. And, above all, the backing of the crowd will be required, driven by the attitude of the players on the pitch, by their grit and their courage, to push the entire team beyond their own limits.
